verdict.rationale: Smithery once documented 'Triggers', where it proxied a consumer's subscribe call to an MCP server and the server, not Smithery, POSTed events to the consumer. Smithery's own shutdown notice says the Smithery API, Connect and accounts stopped working on 2026-10-31, leaving only a public non-proxied registry with no documented API surface. So the product no longer offers a webhook subscription a programmatic consumer can register against, and even before shutdown Smithery was not the party delivering the callbacks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
